<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that, in the forward direction, breaks a ketone and a C‑C triple bond, forms a new C‑C bond (6‑6), and breaks a C‑O bond (6‑8). This matches the described cycloaddition transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
  "bonds_broken": ["6-8"]
}</action_input>
